registry_server.description: Standalone App Reviewer Airtable MCP for performant bounded access to Assets and Asset Versions, including allowlisted reviewer writes

dify_studio_steps: Create an HTTP MCP server card with server ID app-reviewer-airtable.
Transcribe every discovered tool into config/dify/inventory.json with risk classification; classify the two update tools as bounded write tools.
Run pnpm dify:inventory:generate and pnpm dify:coverage:generate.
notes: This intake artifact is not a Dify inventory entry.
Do not paste the inventory fragment until Dify Studio has discovered tools and each tool is classified.
Expected tool count is 7: five read tools plus app_reviewer_update_asset_fields and app_reviewer_update_asset_version_fields.
The update tools are allowlisted Airtable writes and support dry_run=true for validation without mutation.
Keep MCP_BEARER_TOKEN and AIRTABLE_API_KEY in Infisical only; this artifact stores references, not values.
The Worker must also receive AIRTABLE_API_KEY from Infisical or a Worker secret before Dify discovery can read or write live Airtable data.
